entries.title: II Corinthians 13:1
segments: ¶This [will be] the third [time] I am coming to you. "By the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established."

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:2
segments: I have told you before, and foretell as if I were present the second time, and now being absent I write to those who have sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare--

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:3
segments: since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, who is not weak toward you, but mighty in you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:4
segments: For though He was crucified in weakness, yet He lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in Him, but we shall live with Him by the power of God toward you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:5
segments: Examine yourselves [as to] whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Do you not know yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you? --unless indeed you are disqualified.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:6
segments: But I trust that you will know that we are not disqualified.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:7
segments: ¶Now I pray to God that you do no evil, not that we should appear approved, but that you should do what is honorable, though we may seem disqualified.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:8
segments: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:9
segments: For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. And this also we pray, that you may be made complete.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:10
segments: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the authority which the Lord has given me for edification and not for destruction.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:11
segments: ¶Finally, brethren, farewell. Become complete. Be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:12
segments: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

entries.title: II Corinthians 13:14
segments: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit [be] with you all. Amen.
